header: What a month costs your practice
lead: Five figures decide a Talbrunn invoice. Take them off last month's practice statistics and the arithmetic below gives you the month before it happens.
bodytext:
Monthly total = plan price + (practitioners above the plan × band rate) + (extra addresses × €25) + (SMS sent × €0.08) + (recall letters × €0.95) + (storage above 20 GB × €0.90) + add-ons

A worked example. A practice with seven practitioners at two addresses, sending about 400 SMS and 60 recall letters a month, storing 24 GB and running online booking:

€89 plan + (2 × €18) + (1 × €25) + (400 × €0.08) + (60 × €0.95) + (4 × €0.90) + €19 = €260.60 net, or €312.72 including 20 % VAT.

One-off charges — migration, training, terminal setup — are not part of this sum. They appear once, on the invoice for the month the work was done.
note: The rates below are the standing ones. A practice on a written offer uses the figures in that offer, which override anything on this page for the term it covers.
cta_label: Ask us to check your numbers

inputs.title: Plan price
inputs.text: Einzel €39, Praxis €89, Verbund €169. One line per practice, whatever the month brings.

inputs.title: Practitioners above the plan
inputs.text: Count the practitioner accounts on the first of the month, subtract those the plan includes, and read the band rate.

inputs.title: Extra treatment addresses
inputs.text: Per address beyond the first, counted on the first of the month.

inputs.title: SMS reminders
inputs.text: Roughly one per appointment where the patient asked for one. Last month's figure is on your practice statistics page.

inputs.title: Printed recall letters
inputs.text: Only letters actually printed and posted. Recalls answered by e-mail cost nothing.

inputs.title: Document storage above 20 GB
inputs.text: Per gigabyte, measured on the last day of the month. A practice scanning every prescription reaches 20 GB in about three years.

inputs.title: Add-ons
inputs.text: Add together whatever is switched on: online booking, patient app, waiting-list automation, second data location.
